scope_change_reason: The card asks for one selected supplier obligation traced through its source-bound checks with one semantically invalid but well-formed fixture. The traced obligation is the source-binding/coverage obligation of the selected record (the audited sources are the consumed sources), narrowed to the pin boundary of the acceptance path; the historical owner audit example (bridge-omission timing blind spot) was already spent on PR626 and its current-chain successor is covered by adjacent packages, while the byte-coverage question is untouched by any live claim found at 2026-10-14 12:01 UTC.
stop_rule: Stop after the deterministic binding table, the seven fixtures through the real check() (three rejections of bound mutations, one uncovered-proof rejection, one decimal rejection, three acceptances of unbound mutations) and the literal-scan control; no full cold replay, no pinned-verifier edits, no further mutation classes.
